##### Project general facts

Cala Del Mar is a distinctive marine-inspired residential development that redefines coastal living through elegant architecture and a strong connection to its natural surroundings. The design draws inspiration from the fluidity of the ocean and the refined aesthetics of luxury yachts, creating a sculptural composition with organic forms and expansive glass elements. Residences are designed with open layouts and floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flow through the interiors while capturing panoramic views of the sea and sky.

The development offers a lifestyle centered around openness, tranquility, and connection to nature. Thoughtfully designed spaces reflect the rhythm of the surrounding environment, creating a serene atmosphere for relaxation and everyday living. The project emphasizes a private and exclusive setting, where residents can enjoy a calm coastal experience complemented by well-planned communal areas and a seamless integration with the waterfront.

The interiors feature high-end finishes and bespoke detailing, enhancing the overall maritime concept with a refined and sophisticated touch. Large windows maximize daylight and views, while the kitchens are equipped with modern appliances, sintered stone countertops, and functional layouts. The units are delivered unfurnished, with built-in wardrobes providing practical storage solutions, allowing residents to personalize their homes while enjoying a high standard of comfort and design.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
